question: How can even a wise person be afflicted at the subtle point of nectar?
premises: A subtle point of nectar is indicated
An essence of juice is involved
Even a wise person may burn
inference: Even the wise may experience burning at the subtle nectar point.
uncertainties: The physiological referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are esoteric and ambiguous
plain_english: Even a wise person may burn at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
